name: LSTM
tagline: Two-layer LSTM over Alpha360 reshaped to 60 timesteps × 6 features per stock-day; last-step linear head.
diff_from_baseline: qlib official LSTM baseline (qlib/contrib/model/pytorch_lstm.py) with workflow_config_lstm_Alpha360.yaml hyperparameters. Standard sequence baseline for daily return prediction.

name: LightGBM
tagline: Gradient-boosted decision trees on flat Alpha360 features with strong L1/L2 leaf regularization (qlib official LGB).
pseudocode:
1. Use Alpha360 flat features as tabular input; CSRankNorm of label.
2. Initialize LightGBM with: num_leaves=210, max_depth=8, learning_rate=0.0421, lambda_l1=205.7, lambda_l2=580.98, colsample=0.888, subsample=0.879, objective=mse.
3. Train up to num_boost_round=1000 with early_stopping_rounds=50 on the validation set.
4. Predict next-day return on test segment.
5. Pass scalar predictions to qlib portfolio analysis.
diff_from_baseline: qlib official LGBModel (qlib/contrib/model/gbdt.py) with workflow_config_lightgbm_Alpha360.yaml hyperparameters. The standard tabular baseline on Alpha360; CSRankNorm label preprocessing tailored for tree models.

name: Transformer
tagline: Two-layer transformer encoder on Alpha360 sequences (60 days × 6 feats), sin/cos positional encoding, last-step head.
diff_from_baseline: qlib official TransformerModel (qlib/contrib/model/pytorch_transformer.py) with workflow_config_transformer_Alpha360.yaml hyperparameters. Standard sequence-transformer baseline on the Alpha360 feature suite.
